name: Video
description: Video module rendering YouTube/Vimeo/custom embeds behind a poster with play overlay. Layouts: split with text beside the video, full-width video on top, background overlay with speaker attribution, or a card grid of multiple videos that open in a modal player.
when_to_use: Explainers, image films, testimonial videos, or a webinar/video library (cards variant). Use Hero with a video background for ambient motion without playback controls.
capabilities: YouTube / Vimeo IDs or custom embed URLs; poster image with play button until click
inline playback for single-video variants, modal player for the card grid
numbered bullet list of process steps/key points (split and full-top variants)
speaker name + role attribution (overlay variant), duration label and per-card category

variants.description: Video left, text + bullets right. Default.
Full-width video above the text block.
Hero-like background treatment with speaker_name/speaker_role over the video.
Grid of cards[] videos; clicking opens a modal player.

breakpoints.mobile: Splits stack video above text; cards go single column.
breakpoints.desktop: Two-column splits; card grid in 2-3 columns.

ai.prompt_summary: Video: video section. Settings: variant (split-left|split-right|full-top|overlay|cards), eyebrow, headline, body, cta_label + cta_to, speaker_name + speaker_role (overlay), video_provider (youtube|vimeo|custom), video_id (ID, or full embed URL for custom), duration (e.g. '4:18'), poster. bullets[] (split/full-top): { title, description }. cards[] (cards variant): { title, category, duration, video_provider, video_id, poster }.
ai.content_guidelines: Always provide a poster image. 2-4 bullets with 1-sentence descriptions. Card grids: 3-6 videos with short titles and a category each.

field_hints.video_id: Plain YouTube/Vimeo ID; only a full embed URL when provider is custom.
field_hints.bullets: Numbered automatically; used by split-* and full-top variants.
field_hints.cards: Only rendered by the cards variant; each card opens its video in a modal.
